item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
What's New in FSeq 0.2.2

🐞 Fixes

  • Import to After Effects: File and folder names with Chinese (or any other non-English) characters now import correctly instead of arriving garbled in After Effects.
  • Convert to MP4/GIF: Opening the convert dialog for files with non-English names no longer risks an error on Windows.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
What's New in FSeq 0.2.1

✨ New

  • Convert to MP4: Right-click sequences to convert to MP4 via ffmpeg. Converted files are revealed in Finder/Explorer automatically.
  • Convert to GIF: Right-click MP4 files to convert to GIF with customizable settings dialog and ffmpeg logging.

🐞 Fixes

  • Send to After Effects: Simplified dispatch to mirror the proven pattern from AEC4D Pro. Handle cloud-streaming source folders (Google Drive for Desktop, OneDrive Files On-Demand, Dropbox Smart Sync, etc.) natively via its own import path.
  • Fixed errors when converting or deleting files
  • Fixed a crash on startup for trial licenses
  • Windows updates: Updates now install in the background and restart FSeq automatically, without the setup wizard.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
What's New in FSeq 0.2.0

✨ New

  • Auto-update system: Check for updates and download them automatically. Powered by Sparkle 2.x (macOS) and WinSparkle (Windows) with EdDSA signing. Available updates show as a badge on the tray icon.
  • Renamer redesign: Complete UI overhaul inspired by Windows PowerRename. Vertical split layout with token-based patterns ($name, $ext, $date), visual case buttons, per-item checkboxes, and persistent undo history with Ctrl+Z.
  • Right-Click-Menu: Rename & Delete Sequences/Files

💎 Improvements

  • ESC to Abort: Abort all sequence and file searches
  • Drag and Drop: Folder-drag from outside to change rootfolder. Moving/Copying files and sequences out of FSeq
  • PySide upgrade: For future compatibility
  • License framework: Improved
  • Undo for rename and delete (guided Trash restore)
